posts.author: TJjokerR
posts.title: [Lounge] TJjokerR's gamemode/server
posts.html:
I'm not advertising or anything, I just want to know what you guys think of this, maybe you have some suggestions?

Gameplay
You spawn in the Lounge, you can walk around and talk to NPC's there is local chat and global chat, go stand in line for a gamemode to play it and make money to buy yourself hats/trails/playermodels/weapons and stuff.

Gamemodes
There will be a few gamemodes from css, I am working on a GunGame for garry's mod and a Zombie Escape.
I'm also planning to work on a sassilization like gamemode, but let me finish the easy stuff first

Map changes? Constantly having to join the server?
I was thinking of one big map, with small maps in it, this way you will only be teleported, there will be no map changing or server switching. The Lounge is a small area that won't need much work, the gungame map(for example break_hillbreak isn't that big either. Though zombie escape will have a big map.

So what do you think? Should I do it? Suggestions? Can you help me in a way?
